Nadia Cho: Hi team! Nadia here, starting today on Solutions Eng. Remote East Coast. Quick things: my GitHub SSO isn't linking to my work email and I can't join #solutions. Also curious who's my onboarding buddy? Small fun fact: I collect vintage keyboards. :keyboard: :wave:
Ravi (People Ops): welcome Nadia! :tada: Buddy is Oliver — he'll reach out. Also check your work email for the Okta invite; if it's missing Tess can resend.
Tess (IT): re-sent Okta invite to nadia.cho@redwood.ai and provisioned a temp laptop image. If GitHub SSO still fails, go to https://okta.redwood.internal/app/GitHub and click "Link account" and paste the code here.
Nadia Cho: got the Okta link, clicked and it shows "account linked" but GitHub login gives "no organization access" when I try to access private repos.
Oliver B.: hey Nadia - welcome! I'm your buddy, Oliver. I'll DM you to set up a 1:1. For org access I think you need to be added to team 'solutions'. @Tess can you add her? Also love the vintage keyboard hobby. :heart_eyes: 
Tess (IT): added Nadia to GitHub team 'solutions' and to Slack channel #solutions. Try cloning `git@github.redwood:solutions/playbooks.git` and let me know if you hit ssh key issues.
Nadia Cho: cloning works, thanks! SSH key prompted me to add the new key to my GitHub account. Done. One more Q: who owns the customer onboarding playbooks? I want to review them this week.
Mika (Eng): hey Nadia - I own the playbooks. There's a doc in the repo `playbooks/customer-onboarding.md`. Happy to pair next week and run through a live demo with staging data.
OnboardBot: New hire checklist updated: Nadia Cho added to groups 'solutions', 'internal-101'. Onboarding tasks: 2/6 complete. https://redwood.internal/onboard/2167894321
Nadia Cho: awesome - thanks everyone for the speedy help. Looking forward to the 1:1 Oliver and the pairing, Mika. Also happy to share photos of my keyboards in #random if people want to see. :grinning:
